Prompts

```
['create a NoiseAugmentTransform to mix random noise samples into audio waveforms at a configurable SNR level', 'create a MusicAugmentTransform subclass to augment audio data with music noise samples from a directory', 'create a BackgroundNoiseAugmentTransform to augment audio with background noise samples from WAV files', 'create a BabbleAugmentTransform to mix multiple speech samples together as overlapping babble noise', 'create a SporadicNoiseAugmentTransform to inject short sporadic noise bursts at random positions in audio']
```

